title: Types of Sentences
goal: Classify and control sentences by communicative purpose and by structure — kept strictly as two separate classification systems — then transform, combine, expand and correct sentences with accuracy.

modules.title: Sentence Purpose
modules.description: Classification by communicative purpose: declarative (assertive), interrogative, imperative and exclamatory. Purpose says what a sentence DOES — it is independent of its internal structure.

lessons.title: Declarative (Assertive) Sentences
objectives: Recognise and write statements that give information or opinions
End statements with a full stop
lessons.assessment: Classify 10 sentences by purpose and write 4 correct declaratives

lessons.title: Interrogative Sentences
objectives: Recognise and write questions ending with a question mark
Use inverted and WH-question forms across purposes
lessons.assessment: Write 5 questions (yes/no and WH) correctly punctuated

lessons.title: Imperative Sentences
objectives: Give instructions, commands, invitations and warnings with the base verb
Soften imperatives with please and let's
lessons.assessment: Give 6 instructions including one with let's and one negative imperative

lessons.title: Exclamatory Sentences
objectives: Express strong feeling with what and how exclamations
Punctuate exclamations correctly
lessons.assessment: Transform 5 statements into exclamations and classify purpose of 10 mixed sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Classify and produce all four sentence purposes, correctly distinguished from structure

modules.title: Sentence Structure
modules.description: Classification by internal structure: simple, compound, complex and compound-complex. Structure says how a sentence is BUILT (clause count and type) — it is independent of purpose.

lessons.title: Simple Sentences
objectives: Recognise one-clause sentences including compound subjects and verbs
Avoid the fragment trap when writing simply
lessons.assessment: Identify simple sentences in 10 items including tricky compound subjects

lessons.title: Compound Sentences
objectives: Join independent clauses with and, but, or, so and semicolons
Avoid comma splices and run-ons
lessons.assessment: Combine 8 of 10 clause pairs correctly and fix 3 comma splices

lessons.title: Complex Sentences
objectives: Build sentences with subordinate clauses (because, although, when, if, relative)
Place commas around non-essential clauses
lessons.assessment: Build 8 complex sentences from prompts and identify clause types

lessons.title: Compound-Complex Sentences
objectives: Combine at least two independent and one dependent clause
Classify any sentence by both purpose AND structure independently
lessons.assessment: Write 4 compound-complex sentences and classify 10 sentences by both systems with at least 80 percent accuracy

checkpoint.criteria: Build and classify all four sentence structures, independently of purpose

modules.title: Sentence Operations
modules.description: Working with sentences: polarity and question formation, transformation, combination, expansion and correction — the production skills that make classification useful.

lessons.title: Affirmative and Negative Forms
objectives: Shift polarity accurately across tenses
Avoid double negatives
lessons.assessment: Transform 10 sentences across polarity with 9 correct

lessons.title: Yes/No Questions and WH-Questions
objectives: Form both question families across tenses
Match question types to communication needs
lessons.assessment: Build 10 questions across tenses with 9 correct

checkpoint.criteria: Control polarity and question formation across tenses

lessons.title: Sentence Transformation
objectives: Rewrite sentences keeping meaning identical (voice, structure, word order changes)
Apply exam-style transformation techniques
lessons.assessment: Complete 10 transformations keeping meaning with 8 correct

lessons.title: Sentence Combination
objectives: Combine short sentences into simple, compound and complex forms as needed
Choose combinations that improve flow
lessons.assessment: Combine 6 sentence groups into well-formed varied sentences

checkpoint.criteria: Transform and combine sentences while preserving meaning

lessons.title: Sentence Expansion
objectives: Add adjectives, adverbs, phrases and clauses purposefully
Expand without losing clarity or correctness
lessons.assessment: Expand 5 base sentences in stages, keeping every version grammatical

lessons.title: Sentence Correction
objectives: Diagnose and fix fragments, splices, agreement and tense errors
Self-edit with a systematic checklist
lessons.assessment: Correct 12 of 15 faulty sentences and justify the fixes

checkpoint.criteria: Expand and correct sentences with control and clear justification

exitAssessment.title: Sentence Types Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Classify 20 sentences by purpose AND by structure as independent systems (no conflation); transform polarity and questions across tenses; combine and expand sentences accurately; diagnose and correct 15 faulty sentences including fragments, splices and agreement errors.
